name: git
notes: Built from the unmodified upstream source tarball in a builder stage of runner/Dockerfile (Debian bookworm ships git 2.39; the Implementer's branch guard needs 2.53 or newer, which shows a branch switch to the reference-transaction hook). The archive digest equals the entry for git-2.53.0.tar.xz in the signed sha256sums.asc that kernel.org publishes next to the release. The commit is the one the annotated tag v2.53.0 points at. There is no pinned executable: it is a build result. Only linux-x64 is pinned; another platform needs its own digest here.
